export function useAppCommandShellRoute() {
  const [commandShellRouteActive, setCommandShellRouteActive] = useState(() =>
    isCommandShellHash(window.location.hash),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const syncCommandShellRoute = () => {
      setCommandShellRouteActive(isCommandShellHash(window.location.hash));
    };

    window.addEventListener("hashchange", syncCommandShellRoute);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("hashchange", syncCommandShellRoute);
  }, []);

  const closeCommandShellRoute = () => {
    if (isCommandShellHash(window.location.hash)) {
      window.history.replaceState(
        null,
        "",
        `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}`,
      );
    }
    setCommandShellRouteActive(false);
  };

  return {
    closeCommandShellRoute,
    commandShellRouteActive,
  };
}

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";

import type {
  ConfirmDialogRequest,
  ConfirmHandler,
} from "../shared/confirmHandler";

export function useAppConfirmDialog(): {
  confirmRequest: ConfirmDialogRequest | null;
  requestConfirm: ConfirmHandler;
  resolveConfirm: (confirmed: boolean) => void;
} {
  const [confirmRequest, setConfirmRequest] =
    useState<ConfirmDialogRequest | null>(null);
  const resolverRef = useRef<((confirmed: boolean) => void) | null>(null);

  const resolveConfirm = useCallback((confirmed: boolean) => {
    const resolve = resolverRef.current;
    resolverRef.current = null;
    setConfirmRequest(null);
    resolve?.(confirmed);
  }, []);

  const requestConfirm = useCallback<ConfirmHandler>(
    (message) =>
      new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
        resolverRef.current?.(false);
        resolverRef.current = resolve;
        setConfirmRequest({ message });
      }),
    [],
  );

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      resolverRef.current?.(false);
      resolverRef.current = null;
    },
    [],
  );

  return {
    confirmRequest,
    requestConfirm,
    resolveConfirm,
  };
}

}: {

}): ComposerSlashCommand[] {

  }, [client, cwd, isConnected, isDemoPreview, refreshKey, selectedThreadId]);

import { useMemo } from "react";
import type { Thread } from "@crewon-protocol/v2/Thread";

import type { ConnectionState } from "./appRuntimeState";

export type AppThreadSelectionParams = {
  activeTurnByThread: Record<string, string>;
  connectionState: ConnectionState;
  newDraftThreadLabel: string;
  selectedThreadId: string | null;
  threads: Thread[];
  untitledThreadLabel: string;
};

export function useAppThreadSelection({
  activeTurnByThread,
  connectionState,
  newDraftThreadLabel,
  selectedThreadId,
  threads,
  untitledThreadLabel,
}: AppThreadSelectionParams) {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const selectedThread =
      threads.find((thread) => thread.id === selectedThreadId) ?? null;
    const inProgressTurnId =
      selectedThread?.turns.find((turn) => turn.status === "inProgress")?.id ??
      null;
    const activeTurnId = selectedThreadId
      ? (activeTurnByThread[selectedThreadId] ?? inProgressTurnId)
      : null;

    return {
      activeTurnId,
      cwd: selectedThread?.cwd ?? "",
      isConnected: connectionState === "connected",
      isDemo: connectionState === "demo",
      selectedThread,
      titlebarTitle: selectedThread
        ? threadTitle(selectedThread, untitledThreadLabel)
        : newDraftThreadLabel,
    };
  }, [
    activeTurnByThread,
    connectionState,
    newDraftThreadLabel,
    selectedThreadId,
    threads,
    untitledThreadLabel,
  ]);
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { isCommandShellHash } from "./appRouting";

export function useAppCommandShellRoute() {
  const [commandShellRouteActive, setCommandShellRouteActive] = useState(() =>
    isCommandShellHash(window.location.hash),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const syncCommandShellRoute = () => {
      setCommandShellRouteActive(isCommandShellHash(window.location.hash));
    };

    window.addEventListener("hashchange", syncCommandShellRoute);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("hashchange", syncCommandShellRoute);
  }, []);

  const closeCommandShellRoute = () => {
    if (isCommandShellHash(window.location.hash)) {
      window.history.replaceState(
        null,
        "",
        `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}`,
      );
    }
    setCommandShellRouteActive(false);
  };

  return {
    closeCommandShellRoute,
    commandShellRouteActive,
  };
}

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";

import type {
  ConfirmDialogRequest,
  ConfirmHandler,
} from "../shared/confirmHandler";

export function useAppConfirmDialog(): {
  confirmRequest: ConfirmDialogRequest | null;
  requestConfirm: ConfirmHandler;
  resolveConfirm: (confirmed: boolean) => void;
} {
  const [confirmRequest, setConfirmRequest] =
    useState<ConfirmDialogRequest | null>(null);
  const resolverRef = useRef<((confirmed: boolean) => void) | null>(null);

  const resolveConfirm = useCallback((confirmed: boolean) => {
    const resolve = resolverRef.current;
    resolverRef.current = null;
    setConfirmRequest(null);
    resolve?.(confirmed);
  }, []);

  const requestConfirm = useCallback<ConfirmHandler>(
    (message) =>
      new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
        resolverRef.current?.(false);
        resolverRef.current = resolve;
        setConfirmRequest({ message });
      }),
    [],
  );

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      resolverRef.current?.(false);
      resolverRef.current = null;
    },
    [],
  );

  return {
    confirmRequest,
    requestConfirm,
    resolveConfirm,
  };
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import type { AppServerClient } from "../app-server/appServer";
import {
  loadComposerSlashCommands,
  type ComposerSlashCommand,
} from "../composer/composerSlashCommands";

export function useAppSlashCommands({
  client,
  cwd,
  isConnected,
  isDemoPreview,
  refreshKey = 0,
  selectedThreadId,
}: {
  client: AppServerClient | null | undefined;
  cwd: string;
  isConnected: boolean;
  isDemoPreview: boolean;
  refreshKey?: number;
  selectedThreadId: string | null;
}): ComposerSlashCommand[] {
  const [commands, setCommands] = useState<ComposerSlashCommand[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let canceled = false;

    void loadComposerSlashCommands({
      client,
      cwd,
      isConnected,
      isDemoPreview,
      threadId: selectedThreadId,
    }).then((nextCommands) => {
      if (!canceled) {
        setCommands(nextCommands);
      }
    });

    return () => {
      canceled = true;
    };
  }, [client, cwd, isConnected, isDemoPreview, refreshKey, selectedThreadId]);

  return commands;
}

import { useMemo } from "react";
import type { Thread } from "@crewon-protocol/v2/Thread";

import type { ConnectionState } from "./appRuntimeState";
import { threadTitle } from "../thread/threadModel";

export type AppThreadSelectionParams = {
  activeTurnByThread: Record<string, string>;
  connectionState: ConnectionState;
  newDraftThreadLabel: string;
  selectedThreadId: string | null;
  threads: Thread[];
  untitledThreadLabel: string;
};

export function useAppThreadSelection({
  activeTurnByThread,
  connectionState,
  newDraftThreadLabel,
  selectedThreadId,
  threads,
  untitledThreadLabel,
}: AppThreadSelectionParams) {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const selectedThread =
      threads.find((thread) => thread.id === selectedThreadId) ?? null;
    const inProgressTurnId =
      selectedThread?.turns.find((turn) => turn.status === "inProgress")?.id ??
      null;
    const activeTurnId = selectedThreadId
      ? (activeTurnByThread[selectedThreadId] ?? inProgressTurnId)
      : null;

    return {
      activeTurnId,
      cwd: selectedThread?.cwd ?? "",
      isConnected: connectionState === "connected",
      isDemo: connectionState === "demo",
      selectedThread,
      titlebarTitle: selectedThread
        ? threadTitle(selectedThread, untitledThreadLabel)
        : newDraftThreadLabel,
    };
  }, [
    activeTurnByThread,
    connectionState,
    newDraftThreadLabel,
    selectedThreadId,
    threads,
    untitledThreadLabel,
  ]);
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import {

  type Locale,

type AppShellChromeFrameProps = {

};

export function AppShellChromeFrame({
  appView,
  capabilityDockOpen,
  children,
  hasCapabilityPanel,
  inspectorOpen,
  locale,
  notice,
  platform,
  sidebarOpen,
  theme,
  title,
  onCloseSidebar,
  onDismissNotice,
  onLocaleChange,
  onToggleCapabilityDock,
  onToggleInspector,
  onToggleSidebar,
  onToggleTheme,
}: AppShellChromeFrameProps) {

}

import type { Thread } from "@crewon-protocol/v2/Thread";

import { AppWorkspaceConversationContent } from "./AppWorkspaceConversationContent";
import { AppWorkspaceLibraryContent } from "./AppWorkspaceLibraryContent";
import { AppWorkspaceSettingsContent } from "./AppWorkspaceSettingsContent";
import type { AppView } from "../../lib/shared/appView";
import type { CapabilityPanel } from "../../lib/capability/capabilityPanelTypes";
import type { ComposerSlashCommand } from "../../lib/composer/composerSlashCommands";
import type {
  AgentConfig,
  ArtifactItem,
  LibraryItem,
  LibraryPanel,
  OfficeMember,
  OfficeMemberContextPreview,
  OfficeMemoryListResult,
  OfficeMemoryRecord,
  OfficeMemoryStatus,
  OfficeRunActivity,
  OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,
} from "../../lib/domain/crewonDomain";
import type { LibraryPanelActionCallback } from "../library/LibraryPrimitives";
import type { ConnectionState } from "../../lib/shared/connectionState";
import type { Locale } from "../../lib/i18n";
import type { PlatformKind } from "../../lib/platform";
import type { WorkMode } from "../../lib/workMode";

type AppWorkspaceContentProps = {
  activeTurnId: string | null;
  appView: AppView;
  capabilityPanel: CapabilityPanel | null;
  composerFocusSignal: number;
  composerValue: string;
  connectionState: ConnectionState;
  cwd: string;
  disabled: boolean;
  isSending: boolean;
  libraryPanel: LibraryPanel | null;
  locale: Locale;
  platform: PlatformKind;
  selectedThread: Thread | null;
  selectedThreadId: string | null;
  slashCommands: ComposerSlashCommand[];
  streamingTextByThread: Record<string, string>;
  workMode: WorkMode;
  onApprovalDecision: (id: string, decision: "approved" | "denied") => void;
  onArtifact: (artifact: ArtifactItem) => void;
  onAttachContext: () => void;
  onBackLibrary: () => void;
  onChangeComposerValue: (value: string) => void;
  onItemAction: (item: LibraryItem) => void;
  onLibraryPanelAction: LibraryPanelActionCallback;
  onModeChange: (mode: WorkMode) => void;
  onOfficeDelegationDispatch: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationCancel: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationRetry: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext?: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeVerificationCancel: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    check: OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeVerificationRetry: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    check: OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeMemoryDecision?: (
    memoryId: string,
    status: OfficeMemoryStatus,
  ) => Promise<OfficeMemoryRecord | null>;
  onOfficeMemoryList?: (
    status: OfficeMemoryStatus,
    cursor?: string | null,
  ) => Promise<OfficeMemoryListResult | null>;
  onOfficeMemberContextPreview?: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    member: OfficeMember,
  ) => Promise<OfficeMemberContextPreview | null>;
  onRecruitableAgentList?: (
    existingMembers: OfficeMember[],
  ) => Promise<AgentConfig[]>;
  onOfficeRunCancel: (run: OfficeRunActivity) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeRunRetry: (run: OfficeRunActivity) => void | Promise<void>;
  onPanelAction: (actionId: string) => void;
  onPanelFieldChange: (fieldId: string, value: string) => void;
  onRetryConnection: () => void;
  onSaveAgentConfig: () => void;
  onSend: (text: string) => void;
  onSlashCommandSelect: (command: ComposerSlashCommand) => void;
  onSendOfficeMessage: (text: string) => void | Promise<void>;
  onStop: () => void;
  onThreadSettings: () => void;
  onToggleAgentCapability: (group: "mcp" | "skills", id: string) => void;
  onUpdateAgentConfig: (patch: Partial<AgentConfig>) => void;
};

export function AppWorkspaceContent({
  activeTurnId,
  appView,
  capabilityPanel,
  composerFocusSignal,
  composerValue,
  connectionState,
  cwd,
  disabled,
  isSending,
  libraryPanel,
  locale,
  platform,
  selectedThread,
  selectedThreadId,
  slashCommands,
  streamingTextByThread,
  workMode,
  onApprovalDecision,
  onArtifact,
  onAttachContext,
  onBackLibrary,
  onChangeComposerValue,
  onItemAction,
  onLibraryPanelAction,
  onModeChange,
  onOfficeDelegationDispatch,
  onOfficeDelegationCancel,
  onOfficeDelegationRetry,
  onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext,
  onOfficeVerificationCancel,
  onOfficeVerificationRetry,
  onOfficeMemoryDecision,
  onOfficeMemoryList,
  onOfficeMemberContextPreview,
  onRecruitableAgentList,
  onOfficeRunCancel,
  onOfficeRunRetry,
  onPanelAction,
  onPanelFieldChange,
  onRetryConnection,
  onSaveAgentConfig,
  onSend,
  onSlashCommandSelect,
  onSendOfficeMessage,
  onStop,
  onThreadSettings,
  onToggleAgentCapability,
  onUpdateAgentConfig,
}: AppWorkspaceContentProps) {
  if (appView === "settings") {
    return (
      <AppWorkspaceSettingsContent
        capabilityPanel={capabilityPanel}
        disabled={disabled}
        locale={locale}
        onPanelAction={onPanelAction}
        onPanelFieldChange={onPanelFieldChange}
      />
    );
  }

  if (appView === "library" && libraryPanel) {
    return (
      <AppWorkspaceLibraryContent
        libraryPanel={libraryPanel}
        locale={locale}
        onApprovalDecision={onApprovalDecision}
        onArtifact={onArtifact}
        onBackLibrary={onBackLibrary}
        onItemAction={onItemAction}
        onLibraryPanelAction={onLibraryPanelAction}
        onOfficeRunCancel={onOfficeRunCancel}
        onOfficeRunRetry={onOfficeRunRetry}
        onOfficeDelegationCancel={onOfficeDelegationCancel}
        onOfficeDelegationDispatch={onOfficeDelegationDispatch}
        onOfficeDelegationRetry={onOfficeDelegationRetry}
        onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext={onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext}
        onOfficeVerificationCancel={onOfficeVerificationCancel}
        onOfficeVerificationRetry={onOfficeVerificationRetry}
        onOfficeMemoryDecision={onOfficeMemoryDecision}
        onOfficeMemoryList={onOfficeMemoryList}
        onOfficeMemberContextPreview={onOfficeMemberContextPreview}
        onRecruitableAgentList={onRecruitableAgentList}
        onPanelFieldChange={onPanelFieldChange}
        onSaveAgentConfig={onSaveAgentConfig}
        onSendOfficeMessage={onSendOfficeMessage}
        onToggleAgentCapability={onToggleAgentCapability}
        onUpdateAgentConfig={onUpdateAgentConfig}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <AppWorkspaceConversationContent
      activeTurnId={activeTurnId}
      composerFocusSignal={composerFocusSignal}
      composerValue={composerValue}
      connectionState={connectionState}
      cwd={cwd}
      isSending={isSending}
      locale={locale}
      platform={platform}
      selectedThread={selectedThread}
      selectedThreadId={selectedThreadId}
      slashCommands={slashCommands}
      streamingTextByThread={streamingTextByThread}
      workMode={workMode}
      onAttachContext={onAttachContext}
      onChangeComposerValue={onChangeComposerValue}
      onModeChange={onModeChange}
      onRetryConnection={onRetryConnection}
      onSend={onSend}
      onSlashCommandSelect={onSlashCommandSelect}
      onStop={onStop}
      onThreadSettings={onThreadSettings}
    />
  );
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import { AppShellChrome } from "./AppShellChrome";
import type { AppView } from "../../lib/shared/appView";
import type { NoticeState } from "../../lib/shared/noticeState";
import {
  translate,
  type Locale,
} from "../../lib/i18n";
import type { PlatformKind } from "../../lib/platform";
import type { Theme } from "../../lib/theme";

type AppShellChromeFrameProps = {
  appView: AppView;
  capabilityDockOpen: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
  hasCapabilityPanel: boolean;
  inspectorOpen: boolean;
  locale: Locale;
  notice: NoticeState | null;
  platform: PlatformKind;
  sidebarOpen: boolean;
  theme: Theme;
  title: string;
  onCloseSidebar: () => void;
  onDismissNotice: () => void;
  onLocaleChange: (locale: Locale) => void;
  onToggleCapabilityDock: () => void;
  onToggleInspector: () => void;
  onToggleSidebar: () => void;
  onToggleTheme: () => void;
};

export function AppShellChromeFrame({
  appView,
  capabilityDockOpen,
  children,
  hasCapabilityPanel,
  inspectorOpen,
  locale,
  notice,
  platform,
  sidebarOpen,
  theme,
  title,
  onCloseSidebar,
  onDismissNotice,
  onLocaleChange,
  onToggleCapabilityDock,
  onToggleInspector,
  onToggleSidebar,
  onToggleTheme,
}: AppShellChromeFrameProps) {
  const t = translate(locale);

  return (
    <AppShellChrome
      appView={appView}
      capabilityDockOpen={capabilityDockOpen}
      capabilityLabel={locale === "zh" ? "能力" : "Capabilities"}
      dismissLabel={t.dismiss}
      hasCapabilityPanel={hasCapabilityPanel}
      hideSidebarLabel={t.hideSidebar}
      inspectorLabel={locale === "zh" ? "环境信息" : "Environment"}
      inspectorOpen={inspectorOpen}
      languageLabel={t.language}
      locale={locale}
      notice={notice}
      platform={platform}
      showSidebarLabel={t.showSidebar}
      sidebarOpen={sidebarOpen}
      theme={theme}
      themeLabel={theme === "light" ? t.themeDark : t.themeLight}
      title={title}
      onCloseSidebar={onCloseSidebar}
      onDismissNotice={onDismissNotice}
      onLocaleChange={onLocaleChange}
      onToggleCapabilityDock={onToggleCapabilityDock}
      onToggleInspector={onToggleInspector}
      onToggleSidebar={onToggleSidebar}
      onToggleTheme={onToggleTheme}
    >
      {children}
    </AppShellChrome>
  );
}

import type { Thread } from "@crewon-protocol/v2/Thread";

import { AppWorkspaceConversationContent } from "./AppWorkspaceConversationContent";
import { AppWorkspaceLibraryContent } from "./AppWorkspaceLibraryContent";
import { AppWorkspaceSettingsContent } from "./AppWorkspaceSettingsContent";
import type { AppView } from "../../lib/shared/appView";
import type { CapabilityPanel } from "../../lib/capability/capabilityPanelTypes";
import type { ComposerSlashCommand } from "../../lib/composer/composerSlashCommands";
import type {
  AgentConfig,
  ArtifactItem,
  LibraryItem,
  LibraryPanel,
  OfficeMember,
  OfficeMemberContextPreview,
  OfficeMemoryListResult,
  OfficeMemoryRecord,
  OfficeMemoryStatus,
  OfficeRunActivity,
  OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,
} from "../../lib/domain/crewonDomain";
import type { LibraryPanelActionCallback } from "../library/LibraryPrimitives";
import type { ConnectionState } from "../../lib/shared/connectionState";
import type { Locale } from "../../lib/i18n";
import type { PlatformKind } from "../../lib/platform";
import type { WorkMode } from "../../lib/workMode";

type AppWorkspaceContentProps = {
  activeTurnId: string | null;
  appView: AppView;
  capabilityPanel: CapabilityPanel | null;
  composerFocusSignal: number;
  composerValue: string;
  connectionState: ConnectionState;
  cwd: string;
  disabled: boolean;
  isSending: boolean;
  libraryPanel: LibraryPanel | null;
  locale: Locale;
  platform: PlatformKind;
  selectedThread: Thread | null;
  selectedThreadId: string | null;
  slashCommands: ComposerSlashCommand[];
  streamingTextByThread: Record<string, string>;
  workMode: WorkMode;
  onApprovalDecision: (id: string, decision: "approved" | "denied") => void;
  onArtifact: (artifact: ArtifactItem) => void;
  onAttachContext: () => void;
  onBackLibrary: () => void;
  onChangeComposerValue: (value: string) => void;
  onItemAction: (item: LibraryItem) => void;
  onLibraryPanelAction: LibraryPanelActionCallback;
  onModeChange: (mode: WorkMode) => void;
  onOfficeDelegationDispatch: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationCancel: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationRetry: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext?: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeVerificationCancel: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    check: OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeVerificationRetry: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    check: OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeMemoryDecision?: (
    memoryId: string,
    status: OfficeMemoryStatus,
  ) => Promise<OfficeMemoryRecord | null>;
  onOfficeMemoryList?: (
    status: OfficeMemoryStatus,
    cursor?: string | null,
  ) => Promise<OfficeMemoryListResult | null>;
  onOfficeMemberContextPreview?: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    member: OfficeMember,
  ) => Promise<OfficeMemberContextPreview | null>;
  onRecruitableAgentList?: (
    existingMembers: OfficeMember[],
  ) => Promise<AgentConfig[]>;
  onOfficeRunCancel: (run: OfficeRunActivity) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeRunRetry: (run: OfficeRunActivity) => void | Promise<void>;
  onPanelAction: (actionId: string) => void;
  onPanelFieldChange: (fieldId: string, value: string) => void;
  onRetryConnection: () => void;
  onSaveAgentConfig: () => void;
  onSend: (text: string) => void;
  onSlashCommandSelect: (command: ComposerSlashCommand) => void;
  onSendOfficeMessage: (text: string) => void | Promise<void>;
  onStop: () => void;
  onThreadSettings: () => void;
  onToggleAgentCapability: (group: "mcp" | "skills", id: string) => void;
  onUpdateAgentConfig: (patch: Partial<AgentConfig>) => void;
};

export function AppWorkspaceContent({
  activeTurnId,
  appView,
  capabilityPanel,
  composerFocusSignal,
  composerValue,
  connectionState,
  cwd,
  disabled,
  isSending,
  libraryPanel,
  locale,
  platform,
  selectedThread,
  selectedThreadId,
  slashCommands,
  streamingTextByThread,
  workMode,
  onApprovalDecision,
  onArtifact,
  onAttachContext,
  onBackLibrary,
  onChangeComposerValue,
  onItemAction,
  onLibraryPanelAction,
  onModeChange,
  onOfficeDelegationDispatch,
  onOfficeDelegationCancel,
  onOfficeDelegationRetry,
  onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext,
  onOfficeVerificationCancel,
  onOfficeVerificationRetry,
  onOfficeMemoryDecision,
  onOfficeMemoryList,
  onOfficeMemberContextPreview,
  onRecruitableAgentList,
  onOfficeRunCancel,
  onOfficeRunRetry,
  onPanelAction,
  onPanelFieldChange,
  onRetryConnection,
  onSaveAgentConfig,
  onSend,
  onSlashCommandSelect,
  onSendOfficeMessage,
  onStop,
  onThreadSettings,
  onToggleAgentCapability,
  onUpdateAgentConfig,
}: AppWorkspaceContentProps) {
  if (appView === "settings") {
    return (
      <AppWorkspaceSettingsContent
        capabilityPanel={capabilityPanel}
        disabled={disabled}
        locale={locale}
        onPanelAction={onPanelAction}
        onPanelFieldChange={onPanelFieldChange}
      />
    );
  }

  if (appView === "library" && libraryPanel) {
    return (
      <AppWorkspaceLibraryContent
        libraryPanel={libraryPanel}
        locale={locale}
        onApprovalDecision={onApprovalDecision}
        onArtifact={onArtifact}
        onBackLibrary={onBackLibrary}
        onItemAction={onItemAction}
        onLibraryPanelAction={onLibraryPanelAction}
        onOfficeRunCancel={onOfficeRunCancel}
        onOfficeRunRetry={onOfficeRunRetry}
        onOfficeDelegationCancel={onOfficeDelegationCancel}
        onOfficeDelegationDispatch={onOfficeDelegationDispatch}
        onOfficeDelegationRetry={onOfficeDelegationRetry}
        onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext={onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext}
        onOfficeVerificationCancel={onOfficeVerificationCancel}
        onOfficeVerificationRetry={onOfficeVerificationRetry}
        onOfficeMemoryDecision={onOfficeMemoryDecision}
        onOfficeMemoryList={onOfficeMemoryList}
        onOfficeMemberContextPreview={onOfficeMemberContextPreview}
        onRecruitableAgentList={onRecruitableAgentList}
        onPanelFieldChange={onPanelFieldChange}
        onSaveAgentConfig={onSaveAgentConfig}
        onSendOfficeMessage={onSendOfficeMessage}
        onToggleAgentCapability={onToggleAgentCapability}
        onUpdateAgentConfig={onUpdateAgentConfig}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <AppWorkspaceConversationContent
      activeTurnId={activeTurnId}
      composerFocusSignal={composerFocusSignal}
      composerValue={composerValue}
      connectionState={connectionState}
      cwd={cwd}
      isSending={isSending}
      locale={locale}
      platform={platform}
      selectedThread={selectedThread}
      selectedThreadId={selectedThreadId}
      slashCommands={slashCommands}
      streamingTextByThread={streamingTextByThread}
      workMode={workMode}
      onAttachContext={onAttachContext}
      onChangeComposerValue={onChangeComposerValue}
      onModeChange={onModeChange}
      onRetryConnection={onRetryConnection}
      onSend={onSend}
      onSlashCommandSelect={onSlashCommandSelect}
      onStop={onStop}
      onThreadSettings={onThreadSettings}
    />
  );
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import { AppShellChrome } from "./AppShellChrome";
import type { AppView } from "../../lib/shared/appView";

import {
  translate,
  type Locale,
} from "../../lib/i18n";
import type { PlatformKind } from "../../lib/platform";
import type { Theme } from "../../lib/theme";

type AppShellChromeFrameProps = {
  appView: AppView;
  capabilityDockOpen: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
  hasCapabilityPanel: boolean;
  inspectorOpen: boolean;
  locale: Locale;
  notice: NoticeState | null;
  platform: PlatformKind;
  sidebarOpen: boolean;
  theme: Theme;
  title: string;
  onCloseSidebar: () => void;
  onDismissNotice: () => void;

  onToggleCapabilityDock: () => void;
  onToggleInspector: () => void;
  onToggleSidebar: () => void;
  onToggleTheme: () => void;
};

export function AppShellChromeFrame({
  appView,
  capabilityDockOpen,
  children,
  hasCapabilityPanel,
  inspectorOpen,
  locale,
  notice,
  platform,
  sidebarOpen,
  theme,
  title,
  onCloseSidebar,
  onDismissNotice,
  onLocaleChange,
  onToggleCapabilityDock,
  onToggleInspector,
  onToggleSidebar,
  onToggleTheme,
}: AppShellChromeFrameProps) {
  const t = translate(locale);

  return (
    <AppShellChrome
      appView={appView}
      capabilityDockOpen={capabilityDockOpen}
      capabilityLabel={locale === "zh" ? "能力" : "Capabilities"}
      dismissLabel={t.dismiss}

      hideSidebarLabel={t.hideSidebar}

      inspectorOpen={inspectorOpen}
      languageLabel={t.language}
      locale={locale}
      notice={notice}
      platform={platform}
      showSidebarLabel={t.showSidebar}

      theme={theme}
      themeLabel={theme === "light" ? t.themeDark : t.themeLight}
      title={title}
      onCloseSidebar={onCloseSidebar}
      onDismissNotice={onDismissNotice}
      onLocaleChange={onLocaleChange}
      onToggleCapabilityDock={onToggleCapabilityDock}
      onToggleInspector={onToggleInspector}
      onToggleSidebar={onToggleSidebar}
      onToggleTheme={onToggleTheme}
    >
      {children}
    </AppShellChrome>
  );
}

import { AppWorkspaceConversationContent } from "./AppWorkspaceConversationContent";
import { AppWorkspaceLibraryContent } from "./AppWorkspaceLibraryContent";
import { AppWorkspaceSettingsContent } from "./AppWorkspaceSettingsContent";
import type { AppView } from "../../lib/shared/appView";
import type { CapabilityPanel } from "../../lib/capability/capabilityPanelTypes";
import type { ComposerSlashCommand } from "../../lib/composer/composerSlashCommands";
import type {
  AgentConfig,
  ArtifactItem,
  LibraryItem,
  LibraryPanel,
  OfficeMember,
  OfficeMemberContextPreview,
  OfficeMemoryListResult,
  OfficeMemoryRecord,
  OfficeMemoryStatus,
  OfficeRunActivity,
  OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,
} from "../../lib/domain/crewonDomain";
import type { LibraryPanelActionCallback } from "../library/LibraryPrimitives";
import type { ConnectionState } from "../../lib/shared/connectionState";
import type { Locale } from "../../lib/i18n";
import type { PlatformKind } from "../../lib/platform";
import type { WorkMode } from "../../lib/workMode";

type AppWorkspaceContentProps = {
  activeTurnId: string | null;
  appView: AppView;
  capabilityPanel: CapabilityPanel | null;
  composerFocusSignal: number;
  composerValue: string;
  connectionState: ConnectionState;
  cwd: string;
  disabled: boolean;
  isSending: boolean;
  libraryPanel: LibraryPanel | null;
  locale: Locale;
  platform: PlatformKind;
  selectedThread: Thread | null;
  selectedThreadId: string | null;
  slashCommands: ComposerSlashCommand[];
  streamingTextByThread: Record<string, string>;
  workMode: WorkMode;
  onApprovalDecision: (id: string, decision: "approved" | "denied") => void;
  onArtifact: (artifact: ArtifactItem) => void;
  onAttachContext: () => void;
  onBackLibrary: () => void;
  onChangeComposerValue: (value: string) => void;
  onItemAction: (item: LibraryItem) => void;
  onLibraryPanelAction: LibraryPanelActionCallback;
  onModeChange: (mode: WorkMode) => void;
  onOfficeDelegationDispatch: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationCancel: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationRetry: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext?: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeVerificationCancel: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    check: OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeVerificationRetry: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    check: OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeMemoryDecision?: (
    memoryId: string,
    status: OfficeMemoryStatus,
  ) => Promise<OfficeMemoryRecord | null>;
  onOfficeMemoryList?: (
    status: OfficeMemoryStatus,
    cursor?: string | null,
  ) => Promise<OfficeMemoryListResult | null>;
  onOfficeMemberContextPreview?: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    member: OfficeMember,
  ) => Promise<OfficeMemberContextPreview | null>;
  onRecruitableAgentList?: (
    existingMembers: OfficeMember[],
  ) => Promise<AgentConfig[]>;
  onOfficeRunCancel: (run: OfficeRunActivity) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeRunRetry: (run: OfficeRunActivity) => void | Promise<void>;
  onPanelAction: (actionId: string) => void;
  onPanelFieldChange: (fieldId: string, value: string) => void;
  onRetryConnection: () => void;
  onSaveAgentConfig: () => void;
  onSend: (text: string) => void;
  onSlashCommandSelect: (command: ComposerSlashCommand) => void;
  onSendOfficeMessage: (text: string) => void | Promise<void>;
  onStop: () => void;
  onThreadSettings: () => void;
  onToggleAgentCapability: (group: "mcp" | "skills", id: string) => void;
  onUpdateAgentConfig: (patch: Partial<AgentConfig>) => void;
};

export function AppWorkspaceContent({
  activeTurnId,
  appView,
  capabilityPanel,
  composerFocusSignal,
  composerValue,
  connectionState,
  cwd,
  disabled,
  isSending,
  libraryPanel,
  locale,
  platform,
  selectedThread,
  selectedThreadId,
  slashCommands,
  streamingTextByThread,
  workMode,
  onApprovalDecision,
  onArtifact,
  onAttachContext,
  onBackLibrary,
  onChangeComposerValue,
  onItemAction,
  onLibraryPanelAction,
  onModeChange,
  onOfficeDelegationDispatch,
  onOfficeDelegationCancel,
  onOfficeDelegationRetry,
  onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext,
  onOfficeVerificationCancel,
  onOfficeVerificationRetry,
  onOfficeMemoryDecision,
  onOfficeMemoryList,
  onOfficeMemberContextPreview,
  onRecruitableAgentList,
  onOfficeRunCancel,
  onOfficeRunRetry,
  onPanelAction,
  onPanelFieldChange,
  onRetryConnection,
  onSaveAgentConfig,
  onSend,
  onSlashCommandSelect,
  onSendOfficeMessage,
  onStop,
  onThreadSettings,
  onToggleAgentCapability,
  onUpdateAgentConfig,
}: AppWorkspaceContentProps) {
  if (appView === "settings") {
    return (
      <AppWorkspaceSettingsContent
        capabilityPanel={capabilityPanel}
        disabled={disabled}
        locale={locale}
        onPanelAction={onPanelAction}
        onPanelFieldChange={onPanelFieldChange}
      />
    );
  }

  if (appView === "library" && libraryPanel) {
    return (
      <AppWorkspaceLibraryContent
        libraryPanel={libraryPanel}
        locale={locale}
        onApprovalDecision={onApprovalDecision}
        onArtifact={onArtifact}
        onBackLibrary={onBackLibrary}
        onItemAction={onItemAction}
        onLibraryPanelAction={onLibraryPanelAction}
        onOfficeRunCancel={onOfficeRunCancel}
        onOfficeRunRetry={onOfficeRunRetry}
        onOfficeDelegationCancel={onOfficeDelegationCancel}
        onOfficeDelegationDispatch={onOfficeDelegationDispatch}
        onOfficeDelegationRetry={onOfficeDelegationRetry}
        onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext={onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext}
        onOfficeVerificationCancel={onOfficeVerificationCancel}
        onOfficeVerificationRetry={onOfficeVerificationRetry}
        onOfficeMemoryDecision={onOfficeMemoryDecision}
        onOfficeMemoryList={onOfficeMemoryList}
        onOfficeMemberContextPreview={onOfficeMemberContextPreview}
        onRecruitableAgentList={onRecruitableAgentList}
        onPanelFieldChange={onPanelFieldChange}
        onSaveAgentConfig={onSaveAgentConfig}
        onSendOfficeMessage={onSendOfficeMessage}
        onToggleAgentCapability={onToggleAgentCapability}
        onUpdateAgentConfig={onUpdateAgentConfig}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <AppWorkspaceConversationContent
      activeTurnId={activeTurnId}
      composerFocusSignal={composerFocusSignal}
      composerValue={composerValue}
      connectionState={connectionState}
      cwd={cwd}
      isSending={isSending}
      locale={locale}
      platform={platform}
      selectedThread={selectedThread}
      selectedThreadId={selectedThreadId}
      slashCommands={slashCommands}
      streamingTextByThread={streamingTextByThread}
      workMode={workMode}
      onAttachContext={onAttachContext}
      onChangeComposerValue={onChangeComposerValue}
      onModeChange={onModeChange}
      onRetryConnection={onRetryConnection}
      onSend={onSend}
      onSlashCommandSelect={onSlashCommandSelect}
      onStop={onStop}
      onThreadSettings={onThreadSettings}
    />
  );
}

};

export function AppShellChromeFrame({
  appView,
  capabilityDockOpen,
  children,
  hasCapabilityPanel,
  inspectorOpen,
  locale,
  notice,
  platform,
  sidebarOpen,
  theme,
  title,
  onCloseSidebar,
  onDismissNotice,
  onLocaleChange,
  onToggleCapabilityDock,
  onToggleInspector,
  onToggleSidebar,
  onToggleTheme,
}: AppShellChromeFrameProps) {
  const t = translate(locale);

  return (
    <AppShellChrome

      {children}
    </AppShellChrome>
  );
}

import { AppWorkspaceConversationContent } from "./AppWorkspaceConversationContent";

import type { AppView } from "../../lib/shared/appView";
import type { CapabilityPanel } from "../../lib/capability/capabilityPanelTypes";

import type {
  AgentConfig,
  ArtifactItem,

  LibraryPanel,
  OfficeMember,
  OfficeMemberContextPreview,
  OfficeMemoryListResult,
  OfficeMemoryRecord,
  OfficeMemoryStatus,
  OfficeRunActivity,
  OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,
} from "../../lib/domain/crewonDomain";

import type { Locale } from "../../lib/i18n";
import type { PlatformKind } from "../../lib/platform";
import type { WorkMode } from "../../lib/workMode";

type AppWorkspaceContentProps = {
  activeTurnId: string | null;
  appView: AppView;
  capabilityPanel: CapabilityPanel | null;
  composerFocusSignal: number;
  composerValue: string;
  connectionState: ConnectionState;

    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationRetry: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    delegation: OfficeRunDelegationActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeDelegationDispatchNext?: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  onOfficeVerificationCancel: (
    run: OfficeRunActivity,
    check: OfficeRunVerificationCheckActivity,

  appView,

  libraryPanel,

        onOfficeVerificationRetry={onOfficeVerificationRetry}
        onOfficeMemoryDecision={onOfficeMemoryDecision}
        onOfficeMemoryList={onOfficeMemoryList}
        onOfficeMemberContextPreview={onOfficeMemberContextPreview}

        onPanelFieldChange={onPanelFieldChange}
        onSaveAgentConfig={onSaveAgentConfig}
        onSendOfficeMessage={onSendOfficeMessage}

      onChangeComposerValue={onChangeComposerValue}
      onModeChange={onModeChange}
      onRetryConnection={onRetryConnection}
      onSend={onSend}
      onSlashCommandSelect={onSlashCommandSelect}
      onStop={onStop}
      onThreadSettings={onThreadSettings}
    />
  );
}

payload.message:
现在的前端架构可以概括为：**React 单页应用 + Tauri 桌面壳 + WebSocket JSON-RPC 后端连接 + 手写状态/协调层**。它不是 Redux/Zustand/React Router 那种架构，而是以 `App.tsx` 为总装配器，把状态、effects、coordinators、handlers 和展示组件组合起来。

## 1. 技术底座

路径：`apps/crewon-ui`

主要栈：

- React 19
- TypeScript strict mode
- Vite
- Vitest
- Tauri 2
- Mermaid
- 后端协议类型来自 Rust 生成的 TS schema：

```json
"@crewon-protocol/*": [
  "../../codex-rs/app-server-protocol/schema/typescript/*"
]
```

前端通过 Vite 代理连接后端：

```text
/app-server          -> ws://127.0.0.1:6176
/agent-platform-api  -> http://127.0.0.1:8000
```

---

## 2. 顶层结构

入口链路是：

```text
src/main.tsx
  -> <App />
      -> AppShellChromeFrame
          -> AppWorkspaceNavigationPanel
          -> AppWorkspaceContent
          -> AppWorkspaceSidePanels
          -> AppConfirmDialog
```

特殊情况：如果命中 command shell hash route，会直接渲染：

```text
AppCommandShellRoute
```

也就是说当前有两个顶层 UI 模式：

1. 常规三栏 workspace
2. command shell route

---

## 3. 页面布局架构

常规 UI 是典型工作台结构：

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    App[App.tsx 总装配器]

    App --> Chrome[AppShellChromeFrame]
    Chrome --> Nav[AppWorkspaceNavigationPanel]
    Chrome --> Main[AppWorkspaceContent]
    Chrome --> Side[AppWorkspaceSidePanels]
    Chrome --> Dialog[AppConfirmDialog]

    Main --> Chat[Conversation Content]
    Main --> Library[Library Content]
    Main --> Settings[Settings Content]

    Side --> CapabilityDock[CapabilityDock]
    Side --> Inspector[Inspector]
```

当前主视图只有三个枚举：

```ts
export type AppView = "chat" | "settings" | "library";
```

---

## 4. 状态管理方式

没有使用全局 store。状态主要分散在 `src/lib/app/useApp*.ts` 这些 hook 里，然后由 `App.tsx` 统一装配。

核心状态 hooks：

- `useAppShellRuntimeState`
  - locale
  - theme
  - connectionState
  - notice

- `useAppPanelState`
  - appView
  - settingsSection
  - libraryPanel
  - capabilityPanel

- `useAppChromeState`
  - sidebarOpen
  - capabilityDockOpen
  - inspectorOpen

- `useAppThreadState`
  - threads
  - selectedThreadId
  - activeTurnByThread
  - streamingTextByThread
  - archived/search 状态

- `useAppWorkspaceStatusState`
  - accountStatus
  - conversationSummary
  - gitRemoteDiff
  - threadGoal
  - activeFileWatch
  - busyToolId

- `useAppComposerState`
  - composerValue
  - workMode
  - pending mentions
  - pending context file
  - slash command refresh key

- `useAppPendingServerRequests`
  - approval request
  - user input request
  - dynamic tool request
  - MCP elicitation request
  - external secret request

- `useAppTerminalState`
  - terminalCommand
  - terminalProcessIdRef

这套设计的特点是：**状态局部、显式、靠 props 和 callbacks 下传**。优点是透明，缺点是 `App.tsx` 会变得很重。

---

## 5. 业务协调层

`src/lib/app` 是前端最核心的 orchestration 层。它把 UI 事件、后端 RPC、状态更新串起来。

主要分三类：

### hooks

```text
src/lib/app/useApp*.ts
```

用于创建状态或 memoized handler set。

### effects

```text
src/lib/app/effects/
```

负责副作用，例如：

- 连接 app-server
- 加载 thread list
- 同步 view
- 加载 thread metadata
- 响应超时检测
- 键盘快捷键
- 偏好设置持久化

### handlers / coordinators

```text
src/lib/app/handlers/
src/lib/app/*Coordinator.ts
```

负责把业务动作组织起来，例如：

- `createAppThreadRuntimeHandlers`
- `createAppShellActionHandlers`
- `createAppCapabilityPanelHandlers`
- `createAppDomainBackendCoordinator`
- `createAppDomainActionCoordinator`
- `createAppLibraryOpenCoordinator`
- `createAppLibraryPanelDispatchCoordinator`
- `createAppOfficeRuntimeCoordinator`
- `createAppSettingsCoordinator`

这说明当前前端不是“组件自己直接调后端”的模式，而是：

```text
组件事件
  -> App.tsx callback
    -> handler/coordinator
      -> AppServerClient / domain lib
        -> setState / notification update
```

---

## 6. 后端通信层

核心文件：

```text
src/lib/app-server/appServer.ts
```

这里定义了 `AppServerClient`，它是一个巨大的 JSON-RPC facade。

连接行为：

1. 创建 WebSocket
2. open 后发送 `initialize`
3. 再发送 `initialized` notification
4. 所有请求通过 `request(method, params)`
5. 用 `pending Map` 按 id 匹配响应
6. 后端 notification 交给 `onNotification`
7. 后端主动 request 交给 `onServerRequest`

简化数据流：

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant UI as React UI
    participant App as App.tsx / coordinators
    participant Client as AppServerClient
    participant Server as crewon-app-server

    UI->>App: 用户操作
    App->>Client: request(method, params)
    Client->>Server: WebSocket JSON-RPC
    Server-->>Client: response
    Server-->>Client: notification stream
    Client-->>App: onNotification / onServerRequest
    App-->>UI: setState 后重新渲染
```

---

## 7. 领域模块

`src/lib` 下是按业务域拆分的逻辑模块：

```text
lib/account
lib/agent-config
lib/agent-platform
lib/app
lib/app-server
lib/automation
lib/backend
lib/capability
lib/composer
lib/context
lib/domain
lib/draft
lib/external-agent
lib/file
lib/knowledge
lib/library
lib/mcp
lib/office
lib/plugin
lib/remote
lib/server-request
lib/settings
lib/shared
lib/theme
lib/thread
lib/worktree
```

其中比较关键的是：

- `lib/app`：应用级编排层
- `lib/app-server`：后端 RPC client
- `lib/domain`：Crewon domain 类型、持久化、后端适配
- `lib/thread`：thread/turn/message 模型
- `lib/library`：插件、技能、agent、office、knowledge 等 library 面板动作
- `lib/office`：office workspace 相关逻辑
- `lib/mcp`：MCP 配置和展示逻辑
- `lib/settings`：设置页逻辑

---

## 8. 展示组件层

`src/components` 主要是 UI 组件：

```text
components/
  app/
  activity/
  agents/
  library/
  office/
  settings/
  Transcript*
  Composer*
  Sidebar*
  Inspector*
  Capability*
  TitleBar*
```

大致职责：

- `components/app`：应用框架和 workspace 组合
- `components/activity`：活动流、审批、artifact、预算、trace
- `components/agents`：Agent 配置页面
- `components/library`：library 通用页面
- `components/office`：office workspace
- `components/settings`：设置页
- `Transcript*`：对话/消息/工具卡片渲染
- `Composer*`：输入框和上下文栏
- `Sidebar*`：会话列表和导航
- `Capability*`：右侧能力面板

这些组件整体偏 presentational，复杂业务逻辑主要在 `lib`。

---

## 9. 样式架构

当前是全局 CSS：

```text
src/styles/app.css
src/styles/original-shell-overrides.css
```

没有看到 CSS Modules、Tailwind 或 styled-components。样式集中在全局 class 上。

---

## 10. 当前架构的优缺点

### 优点

- 分层比较清楚：组件、app orchestration、domain logic、RPC client 基本分开。
- TS 类型直接来自 Rust protocol schema，前后端协议一致性较好。
- 不依赖重型全局状态库，状态流显式。
- handler/coordinator 模式方便单测；当前很多 `*.test.ts` 已经覆盖 action/helper 层。

### 问题

- `App.tsx` 过重，承担了太多装配职责。
- `AppServerClient` 非常大，几乎是所有后端 API 的巨型 facade。
- props drilling 很明显，尤其 `AppWorkspaceContent` / `AppWorkspaceSidePanels` 参数很多。
- `lib/app` 已经是高耦合 orchestration 层，继续加功能容易膨胀。
- UI 路由很轻量，目前主要靠 `AppView` 和 hash route，不是完整 router 架构。

---

## 11. 如果后续继续开发，建议按这个边界走

新增 UI 功能时，比较符合当前项目风格的路径是：

1. 后端 API 已有：先在 `AppServerClient` 增加 typed wrapper。
2. 领域逻辑放到对应 `lib/<domain>`。
3. 应用级串联放到 `lib/app/handlers` 或 coordinator。
4. 展示组件放到 `components/<domain>`。
5. `App.tsx` 只做装配，尽量不要继续塞业务逻辑。
6. 如果是新主视图，扩展 `AppView`，再接入 `AppWorkspaceContent` 和 navigation。

- `App.tsx` 过重，承担了太多装配职责。
- `AppServerClient` 非常大，几乎是所有后端 API 的巨型 facade。
- props drilling 很明显，尤其 `AppWorkspaceContent` / `AppWorkspaceSidePanels` 参数很多。

1. 后端 API 已有：先在 `AppServerClient` 增加 typed wrapper。
2. 领域逻辑放到对应 `lib/<domain>`。
3. 应用级串联放到 `lib/app/handlers` 或 coordinator。
4. 展示组件放到 `components/<domain>`。
5. `App.tsx` 只做装配，尽量不要继续塞业务逻辑。
6. 如果是新主视图，扩展 `AppView`，再接入 `AppWorkspaceContent` 和 navigation。

## 1. 技术底座

路径：`apps/crewon-ui`

主要栈：

- React 19
- TypeScript strict mode
- Vite
- Vitest
- Tauri 2
- Mermaid
- 后端协议类型来自 Rust 生成的 TS schema：

```json
"@crewon-protocol/*": [
  "../../codex-rs/app-server-protocol/schema/typescript/*"
]
```

前端通过 Vite 代理连接后端：

```text
/app-server          -> ws://127.0.0.1:6176
/agent-platform-api  -> http://127.0.0.1:8000
```

---

## 2. 顶层结构

入口链路是：

```text
src/main.tsx
  -> <App />
      -> AppShellChromeFrame
          -> AppWorkspaceNavigationPanel
          -> AppWorkspaceContent
          -> AppWorkspaceSidePanels
          -> AppConfirmDialog
```

特殊情况：如果命中 command shell hash route，会直接渲染：

```text
AppCommandShellRoute
```

也就是说当前有两个顶层 UI 模式：

1. 常规三栏 workspace
2. command shell route

---

## 3. 页面布局架构

常规 UI 是典型工作台结构：

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    App[App.tsx 总装配器]

    App --> Chrome[AppShellChromeFrame]
    Chrome --> Nav[AppWorkspaceNavigationPanel]
    Chrome --> Main[AppWorkspaceContent]
    Chrome --> Side[AppWorkspaceSidePanels]
    Chrome --> Dialog[AppConfirmDialog]

    Main --> Chat[Conversation Content]
    Main --> Library[Library Content]
    Main --> Settings[Settings Content]

    Side --> CapabilityDock[CapabilityDock]
    Side --> Inspector[Inspector]
```

当前主视图只有三个枚举：

```ts
export type AppView = "chat" | "settings" | "library";
```

---

## 4. 状态管理方式

没有使用全局 store。状态主要分散在 `src/lib/app/useApp*.ts` 这些 hook 里，然后由 `App.tsx` 统一装配。

核心状态 hooks：

- `useAppShellRuntimeState`
  - locale
  - theme
  - connectionState
  - notice

- `useAppPanelState`
  - appView
  - settingsSection
  - libraryPanel
  - capabilityPanel

- `useAppChromeState`
  - sidebarOpen
  - capabilityDockOpen
  - inspectorOpen

- `useAppThreadState`
  - threads
  - selectedThreadId
  - activeTurnByThread
  - streamingTextByThread
  - archived/search 状态

- `useAppWorkspaceStatusState`
  - accountStatus
  - conversationSummary
  - gitRemoteDiff
  - threadGoal
  - activeFileWatch
  - busyToolId

- `useAppComposerState`
  - composerValue
  - workMode
  - pending mentions
  - pending context file
  - slash command refresh key

- `useAppPendingServerRequests`
  - approval request
  - user input request
  - dynamic tool request
  - MCP elicitation request
  - external secret request

- `useAppTerminalState`
  - terminalCommand
  - terminalProcessIdRef

这套设计的特点是：**状态局部、显式、靠 props 和 callbacks 下传**。优点是透明，缺点是 `App.tsx` 会变得很重。

---

## 5. 业务协调层

`src/lib/app` 是前端最核心的 orchestration 层。它把 UI 事件、后端 RPC、状态更新串起来。

主要分三类：

### hooks

```text
src/lib/app/useApp*.ts
```

用于创建状态或 memoized handler set。

### effects

```text
src/lib/app/effects/
```

负责副作用，例如：

- 连接 app-server
- 加载 thread list
- 同步 view
- 加载 thread metadata
- 响应超时检测
- 键盘快捷键
- 偏好设置持久化

### handlers / coordinators

```text
src/lib/app/handlers/
src/lib/app/*Coordinator.ts
```

负责把业务动作组织起来，例如：

- `createAppThreadRuntimeHandlers`
- `createAppShellActionHandlers`
- `createAppCapabilityPanelHandlers`
- `createAppDomainBackendCoordinator`
- `createAppDomainActionCoordinator`
- `createAppLibraryOpenCoordinator`
- `createAppLibraryPanelDispatchCoordinator`
- `createAppOfficeRuntimeCoordinator`
- `createAppSettingsCoordinator`

这说明当前前端不是“组件自己直接调后端”的模式，而是：

```text
组件事件
  -> App.tsx callback
    -> handler/coordinator
      -> AppServerClient / domain lib
        -> setState / notification update
```

---

## 6. 后端通信层

核心文件：

```text
src/lib/app-server/appServer.ts
```

这里定义了 `AppServerClient`，它是一个巨大的 JSON-RPC facade。

连接行为：

1. 创建 WebSocket
2. open 后发送 `initialize`
3. 再发送 `initialized` notification
4. 所有请求通过 `request(method, params)`
5. 用 `pending Map` 按 id 匹配响应
6. 后端 notification 交给 `onNotification`
7. 后端主动 request 交给 `onServerRequest`

简化数据流：

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant UI as React UI
    participant App as App.tsx / coordinators
    participant Client as AppServerClient
    participant Server as crewon-app-server

    UI->>App: 用户操作
    App->>Client: request(method, params)
    Client->>Server: WebSocket JSON-RPC
    Server-->>Client: response
    Server-->>Client: notification stream
    Client-->>App: onNotification / onServerRequest
    App-->>UI: setState 后重新渲染
```

---

## 7. 领域模块

`src/lib` 下是按业务域拆分的逻辑模块：

```text
lib/account
lib/agent-config
lib/agent-platform
lib/app
lib/app-server
lib/automation
lib/backend
lib/capability
lib/composer
lib/context
lib/domain
lib/draft
lib/external-agent
lib/file
lib/knowledge
lib/library
lib/mcp
lib/office
lib/plugin
lib/remote
lib/server-request
lib/settings
lib/shared
lib/theme
lib/thread
lib/worktree
```

其中比较关键的是：

- `lib/app`：应用级编排层
- `lib/app-server`：后端 RPC client
- `lib/domain`：Crewon domain 类型、持久化、后端适配
- `lib/thread`：thread/turn/message 模型
- `lib/library`：插件、技能、agent、office、knowledge 等 library 面板动作
- `lib/office`：office workspace 相关逻辑
- `lib/mcp`：MCP 配置和展示逻辑
- `lib/settings`：设置页逻辑

---

## 8. 展示组件层

`src/components` 主要是 UI 组件：

```text
components/
  app/
  activity/
  agents/
  library/
  office/
  settings/
  Transcript*
  Composer*
  Sidebar*
  Inspector*
  Capability*
  TitleBar*
```

- `components/app`：应用框架和 workspace 组合
- `components/activity`：活动流、审批、artifact、预算、trace
- `components/agents`：Agent 配置页面

- `components/office`：office workspace
- `components/settings`：设置页
- `Transcript*`：对话/消息/工具卡片渲染
- `Composer*`：输入框和上下文栏
- `Sidebar*`：会话列表和导航
- `Capability*`：右侧能力面板

这些组件整体偏 presentational，复杂业务逻辑主要在 `lib`。

---

## 9. 样式架构

当前是全局 CSS：

```text
src/styles/app.css
src/styles/original-shell-overrides.css

| 顶层装配器 | `apps/crewon-ui/src/App.tsx` | 组合全局状态、effects、handlers、coordinators 和页面组件 | 当前最重的文件，承担大量编排逻辑 |
| UI Shell | `components/app/AppShellChromeFrame.tsx`、`AppShellChrome.tsx` | 桌面/网页外壳、标题栏、侧边栏开关、主题、语言、通知 | 偏展示层，逻辑主要由 `App.tsx` 注入 |
| 主导航区 | `components/app/AppWorkspaceNavigationPanel.tsx`、`Sidebar*` | 会话列表、搜索、归档、新建会话、设置入口、Library 入口 | 左侧导航结构清晰 |
| 主内容区 | `components/app/AppWorkspaceContent.tsx` | 根据 `appView` 渲染 chat / library / settings | 当前核心视图只有 `"chat" \| "library" \| "settings"` |
| 会话内容 | `AppWorkspaceConversationContent.tsx`、`Transcript*`、`Composer*` | 对话流、消息渲染、Markdown、工具卡片、输入框 | 近期改动较多，Transcript/CommandWorkspace 是活跃区域 |
| Library 内容 | `components/library/*`、`components/agents/*`、`components/office/*` | Agent、Office、Knowledge、Plugin、Tool 等资源面板 | 业务域多，依赖 `lib/domain` 和 `lib/library` |
| Settings 内容 | `components/settings/*` | 设置页导航和内容展示 | 通过 `settingsSection` 控制当前设置页 |
| 右侧能力面板 | `components/CapabilityDock.tsx`、`CapabilityResultPanel.tsx` | 文件、Web、终端、审批、工具执行等能力面板 | 由 `capabilityPanel` 驱动 |
| 右侧 Inspector | `components/Inspector.tsx` | 展示账户、会话摘要、Git diff、thread goal、连接信息等环境状态 | 仅在 chat view 下显示 |
| Command Shell 路由 | `components/app/AppCommandShellRoute.tsx` | hash route 下的特殊命令式界面 | 独立于常规三栏 workspace 渲染 |
| 应用状态 hooks | `lib/app/useApp*.ts` | 管理连接、thread、composer、panel、pending request、terminal 等状态 | 没有 Redux/Zustand，全靠 React state + refs |
| 应用副作用 | `lib/app/effects/*` | 连接后端、加载会话、同步视图、监听快捷键、处理超时、同步偏好 | 副作用已从 `App.tsx` 拆出一部分 |
| 应用 handlers | `lib/app/handlers/*` | 处理 UI 动作：thread、shell、library、settings、capability、server event 等 | 业务编排主要集中在这里 |
| Coordinators | `lib/app/*Coordinator.ts` | 串联 domain、backend、library、office、settings 等复杂业务流程 | 是前端 orchestration 层，继续扩张会变重 |
| 后端 RPC Client | `lib/app-server/appServer.ts` | WebSocket JSON-RPC client，封装 app-server API | 巨型 facade，方法很多，是主要耦合点 |
| 协议类型 | `codex-rs/app-server-protocol/schema/typescript` | Rust 后端协议生成的 TypeScript 类型 | 保证前后端 API 类型一致 |
| 领域逻辑 | `lib/domain`、`lib/thread`、`lib/library`、`lib/office`、`lib/mcp` 等 | 各业务域的数据模型、动作、展示辅助逻辑 | 领域拆分较细，测试覆盖较多 |
| 平台适配 | `lib/platform.ts`、`src-tauri/*` | 判断 mac/windows/web，Tauri 桌面壳配置 | UI 同时面向 Web 和桌面 |
| 构建配置 | `vite.config.ts`、`package.json`、`tsconfig.json` | Vite dev/build、proxy、manual chunks、TS strict 配置 | `/app-server` 代理 WebSocket 到本地后端 |
| 样式 | `styles/app.css`、`styles/original-shell-overrides.css` | 全局样式和旧 shell override | 没有 CSS Modules/Tailwind，样式集中度较高 |
| 测试 | `*.test.ts`、`*.test.tsx` | Vitest 单测，覆盖 action/helper/component 行为 | 很多业务逻辑适合继续放在可测 lib 层 |

总体一句话：当前前端是 **React + Vite + Tauri 的单页工作台架构，`App.tsx` 负责总装配，`lib/app` 负责应用级编排，`AppServerClient` 通过 WebSocket JSON-RPC 连接 Rust app-server，展示组件主要集中在 `components` 下**。

payload.message:
后端是一个 **Rust 多 crate 的 Agent runtime 架构**，核心入口是 `crewon-app-server`。

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    UI[前端 / PC Web Mobile] -->|WebSocket JSON-RPC| AppServer[crewon-app-server]

    AppServer --> Protocol[crewon-app-server-protocol]
    AppServer --> Core[crewon-core]
    AppServer --> Store[thread-store / rollout / state]

    Core --> Tools[crewon-tools / skills / MCP / shell]
    Core --> Config[crewon-config]
    Core --> Model[model-provider / crewon-client / crewon-api]
    Core --> Sandbox[sandboxing / exec-server]

    Model --> Provider[OpenAI / Claude / Qwen / GLM 等]
```

| 层 | 主要 crate / 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| 后端入口 | `codex-rs/app-server` | 启动服务，处理 JSON-RPC 请求，管理连接和通知流 |
| 协议层 | `codex-rs/app-server-protocol` | 定义 v2 API 类型，生成 TypeScript/schema |
| Agent 核心 | `codex-rs/core` | 执行 agent turn、上下文、工具调用、审批、模型交互 |
| 持久化 | `thread-store`、`rollout`、`state` | 保存会话、turn、历史记录、本地状态 |
| 工具系统 | `crewon-tools`、`core-skills`、`core-plugins`、`ext/*` | shell、patch、MCP、skills、web/image 等工具能力 |
| 模型/账号 | `crewon-client`、`crewon-api`、`crewon-login`、`model-provider` | 登录、鉴权、模型 provider 适配 |
| 执行/沙箱 | `sandboxing`、`exec-server`、`linux-sandbox`、`windows-sandbox-rs` | 命令执行、权限控制、平台沙箱 |

一句话：后端不是普通 REST 服务，而是 **`crewon-app-server` 作为 JSON-RPC 网关，调用 `crewon-core` 跑 Agent，再通过 tools/model/storage/sandbox 子系统完成实际任务**。
